email.description:

- **Options:**
    - **emailDomain** => exemple
    - **emailExtension** => com
- `🔑 Primary` `📋 In List`

phone.description:

body_html.title: Description
body_html.description:
A description of the product. Supports HTML formatting.

- **Microdata:** `http://schema.org/Product` → `description`

product_type.title: Product Type
product_type.description:
A categorization for the product used for filtering and searching products.

- **Microdata:** `http://schema.org/Product` → `additionalType`

handle.title: Friendly URL
handle.description:
A unique human-friendly string for the product. Automatically generated from the product's title.

- **Microdata:** `http://schema.org/Product` → `urlRewrite`
- **Options:**
    - **isLowerCase** => 1

tags.title: Tags
tags.description:
Used for filtering and search. A product can have up to 250 tags.

- **No Sync** — field prefers being left unchanged, without any synchronization
- **Microdata:** `http://schema.org/Product` → `tags`
- **Options:**
    - **isOrdered** => 1
    - **isLowerCase** => 1

sku.title: Product SKU
sku.description:
A unique identifier for the product variant in the shop.

- **Microdata:** `http://schema.org/Product` → `model`
- `🔎 Indexed` `📋 In List`

variant_title.title: Title with Options
variant_title.description:
Title with Options

- **Microdata:** `http://schema.org/Product` → `name`
- `🔎 Indexed` `📋 In List`

position.title: Position
position.description:
Image Order for this Product Variant

- **Microdata:** `http://schema.org/Product` → `positionImage`
- `🧪 No Tests`

visible.title: Visible
visible.description:
Image is visible for this Product Variant

- **Microdata:** `http://schema.org/Product` → `isVisibleImage`
- `🧪 No Tests`
